description: This file defines functions and methods for creating and configuring HTTP clients and transport configurations with support for TLS, authentication, and layered transport wrappers within the Kubernetes client-go library.

classes.name: Config
classes.description: Configuration struct for transport settings, including TLS, authentication, and proxy options.

methods.name: TransportConfig
methods.description: Converts a Config object into a transport.Config suitable for creating HTTP transports.

methods.name: Wrap
methods.description: Adds a transport middleware wrapper function to the Config's transport layer.
